parts.when: [Your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) or [your Charge phase](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase), as it begins.
parts.effect:
These apply to the unit:

- whenever it makes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or [Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move), it can disregard any number of the modifiers to its M, its Advance rolls and its Charge rolls, for the rest of the phase

data.summary:
**When:** [Your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) or [your Charge phase](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase), as it begins.

**Target:** A **WYCH CULT** unit of yours.

**Effect:** These apply to the unit:

- whenever it makes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or [Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move), it can disregard any number of the modifiers to its M, its Advance rolls and its Charge rolls, for the rest of the phase
- whenever a model of the unit makes one of those moves, it can pass horizontally through models and enter their [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) on the way, but cannot end its normal or advance move there, for the rest of the turn
